fields.Name: T049 - Dashboard Rename Persist Round Trip
fields.Description: Exercises the edit-mode header with editingName/editingDescription inputs and the saveDashboard() persist-then-back-to-view code path, then verifies persistence in the list — distinct from create (T105) which only asserts creation, and from generic form field editing.
fields.ExpectedOutcomes:
{
  "goalCompleted": true,
  "minConfidence": 0.7,
  "maxSteps": 35,
  "judgeValidationCriteria": [
    "Edit mode shows an editable dashboard name input (and a description input) with Save and Cancel buttons",
    "After typing a new name and clicking Save, the view returns to view mode without error",
    "Returning to the dashboard list shows the dashboard listed under the new name (the rename persisted)",
    "No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages"
  ]
}
